fusions.name: Mile-Worn Knuckles
fusions.desc: A punch carrying every step behind it, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +50%).

fusions.name: Cartwheel
fusions.desc: You turn over on hands and feet, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you.

fusions.name: Marching Cadence
fusions.desc: You clap out a marching beat: every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Road-Hardened
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
